scripts.assembly: python3 build_assembly.py && python3 build_stickers.py && python3 build_soundtrack.py && node build.mjs
scripts.stickers: python3 build_stickers.py && python3 build_soundtrack.py && node build.mjs --without-narration && python3 regenerate_audio.py && node build.mjs
scripts.audio: node build.mjs --without-narration && python3 regenerate_audio.py && node build.mjs
scripts.render: npx --yes hyperframes@0.6.6 render --fps 30 --quality high --sdr -o renders/print-your-custom-figure-at-home.mp4 && python3 finalize_audio.py
scripts.showcase: python3 prepare_showcase.py && node build.mjs --without-narration && python3 regenerate_audio.py && node build.mjs
